property_summary: For every input, C.transfer must not perform any token movement (i.e., call the token contract) beyond the length of _tos, but the buggy loop i<=_tos.length performs one extra call and reverts on the out-of-bounds access; the test observes the number of calls C makes to the token contract and requires it to equal _tos.length.
change_summary: Change the loop condition to allow an out-of-bounds index when _tos is non-empty.
